api.rateLimited: Too many requests — please slow down

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.

blackboard.pullRequired: Go to the newest entry first, then try again.
blackboard.noData: Nothing to upload. Write something first.

walkieTypie.noLocalData: No messages yet. Start typing to create one.

broadcast.notOwner: Only the owner can do this.

system.loginRequired: Please log in for this action.
system.storageFull: Storage full. Changes may not be saved.

hints.push: Go forward to a newer entry. If you're already at the newest, a blank page appears — type anything and it becomes a new entry.
hints.pull: Go back to an older entry. If you typed something on a blank page, it's saved first.
hints.commit: Upload ALL entries from the selected topic to the cloud, replacing the entire cloud copy. If another device uploaded first, your version wins. File attachments included.
hints.checkout: Download the selected topic from the cloud, replacing your local copy.
hints.switch: Jump to a different topic. If it only exists in the cloud, it's downloaded first.
hints.fork: Copy every entry from the selected topic into a new independent topic. The original and copy are fully separate — changes to one never affect the other.
hints.dropClean: Erase all entries in this topic but keep the topic itself. One blank placeholder remains.
hints.dropDrop: Remove the cloud copy of this topic. Your local entries stay untouched.
hints.dropDelete: Permanently delete this empty topic. Cannot be undone.
hints.themeToggle: Switch between dark and light theme. Requires the Light Theme extension.
hints.shelfHandle: Extension panel handle. Drag left to see more, right to see less. Double-click to close.

wt.theyPush: View a newer entry on your partner's board (read-only).
wt.theyPull: View an older entry on your partner's board (read-only).
wt.wePush: Go forward to a newer entry on your board. Your partner sees changes in real-time. At the newest, a blank page opens for a new message.
wt.wePull: Go back to an older entry on your board. Your text is saved first.
wt.add: Connect with someone by entering their username. You each get your own board — you write on yours, they write on theirs, and both sides are visible in real-time.
wt.cut: Disconnect your selected partner and erase all message history for this pair on both sides.

bc.pin: Save this channel to your favourites. Pinned channels stay at the top of your list.
bc.cast: Upload ALL your local entries to this channel, replacing its entire cloud content. This uploads everything, not just what's on screen.
bc.create: Start a new local channel. Write entries first, then use Publish to make them public.
bc.delete: Permanently delete this channel and all its entries (local and cloud). Only the creator can do this. Cannot be undone.

mods.refresh: Re-check all extensions and update their availability.

config.maxSlot: Max entries per topic. Oldest removed automatically when full.
config.autoCleanBlanks: Remove blank entries automatically when you navigate. Keeps things tidy.
config.updateTimestamp: Move an edited entry to the top (newest). OFF = it stays where it was.
config.autoSync: Automatically upload your changes and download when another device updates. Requires login.
config.loopList: Wrap around: scrolling past the end jumps to the start, and vice versa.
config.boardSwap: Put your board on top, partner's below. Default: partner's messages are on top.
config.screensaverTimeout: Seconds after you leave this tab before the screensaver appears. Set to max to disable.
config.crtBlendMode: Soften the screen lines. Makes the retro look less harsh.

llm.button: Send your text to AI. The result appears in the panel below.
llm.provider: Where AI runs — in your browser (offline, private), on a local server, or in the cloud (needs internet + API key).
llm.clientModel: AI model that runs in your browser. Bigger = smarter, but needs more graphics memory.
llm.apiProvider: Which cloud AI service to use (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.).
llm.apiModel: The specific model from your cloud provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini).
llm.apiKey: Your secret API key. Stored on your device only — never sent to our server.
llm.temperature: How creative the AI is. Low = focused. High = varied. 0.3–0.7 is a good middle ground.

llmBb.button: Have AI analyze your entries (summarize, extract, transform).
llmBb.target: What to analyze: entries from the current topic, the topic list, or all topics combined.

llmBc.button: Have AI analyze the channel content.
llmBc.target: What to analyze: the current entry, or all entries in the channel.

translate.button: Translate your text to another language. Result appears in the panel below.

stt.button: Record from your microphone. Speech is converted to text and inserted into the editor.

markdownPreview.button: See your text as formatted Markdown in the panel below (headings, bold, lists, etc.).

aa.matrixRain: Falling green characters on the idle screen, Matrix-style. Pure decoration.
aa.perlinBg: A gentle flowing texture behind your content. Subtle atmosphere.
aa.mouseLight: A soft glow that follows your cursor, like a flashlight on screen.
aa.toastAnim: A spinning animation on pop-up notifications. Shows that something is processing.

mods.configDefault: Select an extension from the list.
mods.catalogPreview: Add this extension to start configuring.
mods.validationFailed: Extension '{id}' failed to load — check console
